source.title: Bitcoin, Markets and Your Questions
source.description: Bitcoin news, markets and your questions, every week. In this episode we go through the week's price action, the on-chain data we watch, and your questions from the comments. Chapters: 00:00 Intro 01:12 Price action 06:40 On-chain 11:05 Your questions 18:30 Wrap-up. If you enjoy the show, subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss an episode, and share it with a friend who is just getting started. Nothing in this video is financial advice; always do your own research before making any decision with your money. Thank you for watching, for the comments and for the support, and we will
